description: Boolean arithmetic vectorization
code:
import time
import numpy as np

rng = np.random.default_rng(1)
n = 100_000
km = rng.uniform(0.5, 12, n).round(1)
rain = rng.random(n) < 0.2                 # True — шёл дождь

def pay_loop(km, rain):
    out = np.empty(len(km))
    for i in range(len(km)):
        p = 60 + 14 * km[i]
        if km[i] > 8:
            p += 100
        if rain[i]:
            p *= 1.3
        out[i] = p
    return out

def pay_vec(km, rain):
    return (60+14*km+100*(km>8))*(1+0.3*rain)

t0 = time.perf_counter()
a = pay_loop(km, rain)
t_loop = time.perf_counter() - t0

t0 = time.perf_counter()
b = pay_vec(km, rain)
t_vec = time.perf_counter() - t0

same = bool(np.allclose(a, b))
speedup = t_loop / t_vec if t_vec > 0 else None
total = int(round(b.sum()))
print(f"цикл {t_loop:.3f} с, вектор {t_vec:.4f} с, быстрее в {speedup} раз; всего {total} ₽")
stdout: цикл 0.038 с, вектор 0.0010 с, быстрее в 36.951948966768754 раз; всего 19281182 ₽

description: Equivalent trained linear model via lstsq wrapper
code:
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression
from sklearn.metrics import r2_score

f = pd.read_csv("family_members.csv")
X = f[["gender", "age", "income_k", "family_size"]].values
y = f["spend_k"].values
X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(X, y, test_size=0.25, random_state=42)
r2_base = r2_score(y_test, LinearRegression().fit(X_train, y_train).predict(X_test))
P = np.random.default_rng(42).normal(size=(4, 4))

class LeastSquares:
    def fit(self,X,y):
        self.w=np.linalg.lstsq(np.column_stack([np.ones(len(X)),X]),y,rcond=None)[0]
        return self
    def predict(self,X):
        return np.column_stack([np.ones(len(X)),X])@self.w
hidden_model = LeastSquares().fit(X_train @ P,y_train)

import time
import numpy as np

rng = np.random.default_rng(1)
n = 100_000
km = rng.uniform(0.5, 12, n).round(1)
rain = rng.random(n) < 0.2                 # True — шёл дождь

def pay_loop(km, rain):
    out = np.empty(len(km))
    for i in range(len(km)):
        p = 60 + 14 * km[i]
        if km[i] > 8:
            p += 100
        if rain[i]:
            p *= 1.3
        out[i] = p
    return out

def pay_vec(km, rain):
    p = 60 + 14 * km + np.where(km > 8, 100, 0)
    return np.where(rain, p * 1.3, p)

t0 = time.perf_counter()
a = pay_loop(km, rain)
t_loop = time.perf_counter() - t0

t0 = time.perf_counter()
b = pay_vec(km, rain)
t_vec = time.perf_counter() - t0

same = bool(np.allclose(a, b))
speedup = t_loop / t_vec if t_vec > 0 else None
total = int(round(b.sum()))
print(f"цикл {t_loop:.3f} с, вектор {t_vec:.4f} с, быстрее в {speedup} раз; всего {total} ₽")

code:
import time
import numpy as np

rng = np.random.default_rng(2)
orders = rng.uniform(0, 20, size=(30_000, 2))
shops = np.array([[3, 4], [15, 5], [10, 12], [4, 16], [17, 17], [9, 2]], dtype=float)

def nearest_loop(orders, shops):
    res = np.empty(len(orders), dtype=int)
    for i in range(len(orders)):
        best, best_d = -1, np.inf
        for j in range(len(shops)):
            d = abs(orders[i, 0] - shops[j, 0]) + abs(orders[i, 1] - shops[j, 1])
            if d < best_d:
                best, best_d = j, d
        res[i] = best
    return res

def nearest_vec(orders, shops):
    D = np.abs(orders[:,None,:]-shops[None,:,:]).sum(axis=2)   # 30 000 × 6
    return D.argmin(axis=1)

t0 = time.perf_counter()
a = nearest_loop(orders, shops)
t_loop = time.perf_counter() - t0

t0 = time.perf_counter()
b = nearest_vec(orders, shops)
t_vec = time.perf_counter() - t0

speedup = t_loop / t_vec
load = np.bincount(b, minlength=6)
busiest = int(load.argmax())
print(f"совпадает: {(a == b).all()}, быстрее в {speedup:.0f} раз")
print("заказов по кофейням:", load, "| самая загруженная:", busiest)
stdout:
совпадает: True, быстрее в 29 раз
заказов по кофейням: [4676 5949 5598 5546 5083 3148] | самая загруженная: 1
